create_DonutProcessor: create a DonutProcessor instance with an image_processor and tokenizer for document understanding
process_DonutProcessor_call: process images and text input with DonutProcessor to return encoded inputs with input_ids and labels
get_DonutProcessor_model_input_names: get the model input names from DonutProcessor combining image processor names with input_ids and labels
convert_DonutProcessor_token2json: convert a generated token sequence into an ordered JSON format using DonutProcessor token2json method
configure_DonutProcessorKwargs: configure DonutProcessorKwargs for custom keyword arguments passed to image processor and tokenizer
